name: stevestack
description: Steve's workflow for shipping code: brainstorming, model panels, design docs, working principles, deep review, PR shepherding, diagrams, and Git and test hygiene.

interface.shortDescription: Ship code the way stbenjam does.
interface.longDescription: Brainstorm an idea, convene a panel of models on it, or write it up as a design doc, then take the work to an open, deep-reviewed PR and shepherd it to merge, guided by shared working principles, with box diagrams for docs and PRs and rules for safe Git and test-failure investigation.
interface.defaultPrompt: Ship this work as a deep-reviewed PR.
